name: StageKitWP Members
author: Huw Evans
short_description: A full membership system for theatre groups: roles, invitations, directory, messaging, events with volunteer signup, cast availability, saved email recipient groups, advanced member filters, and REST APIs.
description: StageKitWP Members turns a StageKitWP site into a private members area. Members RSVP to events and sign up for capacity-limited volunteer positions with waitlists; Producers manage position templates and rosters. The plugin also provides member access controls, profiles, messaging, availability, email tools and a capability-gated REST API. Every feature works on MySQL and SQLite.

sections.description: A full membership system for theatre groups, integrated with StageKitWP. Includes roles and invitations, an opt-in member directory, private messaging, events with RSVP and volunteer signup, cast availability, advanced recipient filters, saved email groups, queued campaigns and per-member notification preferences.
sections.installation: 1. Ensure the StageKitWP plugin is installed and active (required). 2. Upload the stagekitwp-members-area folder to wp-content/plugins/. 3. Activate the plugin from Plugins. 4. Roles, capabilities, and database tables are created automatically. 5. Add the member-facing pages using the shortcodes listed below. 6. (Optional) Enable Custom Login, Open Registration, Cloudflare Turnstile, and Nav Menu injection from StageKitWP Members > Settings.
sections.instructions: See the on-site 'Member Instructions' page (slug: /instructions) and docs/shortcodes.md for the complete shortcode list. For volunteer opportunities use [stagekitwp_members_volunteer event_id="123"] or add positions to [stagekitwp_members_events]; members can review status with [stagekitwp_members_my_volunteering]. Signups require member login; public position counts are optional and show no names. Producers manage positions in the event editor or Members Events panel and review/export rosters under Volunteer Roster. Members can subscribe to the event calendar (/events.ics or a personal token feed) and access capability-gated REST endpoints under stagekitwp-ma/v1.
sections.changelog: Events, Announcements and Email Templates now use the native WordPress list/edit screens, with Trash, Delete and a new Duplicate row action. Fixed Producers/Executives being unable to edit or delete Announcements and Email Templates by giving both post types their own capabilities (instead of the generic post capabilities) and granting them to the right roles. See CHANGELOG.md for the full release history.
